scope: Native SSH/PTY and Workspace files/leases against disposable real Fly Machines; two complementary test invocations on the same final source.
gateway: Production SSH adapter, local TCP listener, strict host-key verification; no deployed public endpoint.
control_plane: Owned PostgreSQL/PostgREST with repository migrations and real Project authorization. HTTP identity and billing check are fixture inputs.
creation: Owned WorkbenchChannel allocation and lifecycle initialization; excludes UI, hosted JWT, billing, LLM and Git publication acceptance.

cleanup.cleanup: no test-image Machines; final fixture disk absent or pending_destroy

prior_attempts: Initial attempts recorded Fly TLS handshake/transport failures. They were not counted as passes. Final six scenarios passed after reruns, with per-fixture Machine/Volume cleanup.
performance: Scenario durations include fixture allocation and cleanup; they are not steady-state I/O or provider latency benchmarks.
